Title: IPod touch (6th generation)
iPod touch (6th generation) | Apple Wiki | Fandom. The **6th-generation iPod touch**, colloquially known as the**iPod touch 6G**,**iPod touch 6**, and**iPod touch (2015)**,is a multipurpose handheld device designed and marketed byApple Inc.with a touchscreen-based user interface.#cite_note-1) It is the successor to the5th-generation iPod touch "IPod touch (5th generation)"), becoming the first major update to the iPod lineup in more than two and a half years. It was released through theApple online store "Apple Store (online)")on July 15, 2015, along with updated color options of the7th-generation iPod nano "IPod nano (7th generation)")and4th-generation iPod shuffle "IPod shuffle (4th generation)").#cite_note-2)#cite_note-ninetofivemac-3)The 6th-generation iPod touch was officially discontinued by Apple on May 28, 2019, with the release of its successor, the7th-generation iPod touch "IPod touch (7th generation)"). The 6th-generation iPod touch originally shipped with iOS 8.4, which was released on June 30, 2015, along with the Apple Music streaming service. The 6th-generation iPod touch supports iOS 9 through 12. It has 1 GB of LPDDR3RAM, twice the amount as the previous-generation iPod touch.#cite_note-wired-6) Apple's Metal graphics technology is also compatible with this generation of iPod touch. Unlike the previous-generation version,#cite_note-9) the rear camera on the 6th-generation iPod touch lacks a sapphire crystal lens.#cite_note-10) The front camera is unchanged from the previous generation, a 1.2 MP sensor and can record video up to 720p. 2.   ↑#cite_ref-2 "Jump up")Apple refreshes iPod lineup with new colors and major upgrades to iPod touch by James Vincent and Jacob Kastrenakes, _The Verge_.
